text:
maria: drift-detector alert: networkpolicy/egress mismatch between staging and prod in cluster=gpu-west1. Seen during autoscaler attach -> some pods evicted with 'CNI failed to configure network namespace'.

raj: assigning to me to triage. Is this a helm values drift or terraform change?

maria: env-diff job compared live manifests (flux) vs repo helm values. It flagged that 'networkPolicy.egress.allowedCIDRs' is present in staging (10.0.0.0/16) but empty in prod values-prod.yaml.

infra-bot: policy-check: OPA gate 'restrict-egress' blocked flux release for release/redwood-api-prod at 2024-11-23T14:12Z. See gate log id: gate-9f2b. Recommend fix via repo PR.

sam: seen this before — missing egress to node subnet can break CNI IPAM on GPU nodepools. Quick mitigation is to patch networkpolicy to permit node egress to kube-system/calico and retry scaleup.

jen: can we open a minimal PR to infra/helm/redwood-api/values-prod.yaml with the staged CIDR, and add an env-diff unittest to prevent regressions?

maria: I'll open the PR and also run terraform plan against the nodepool to ensure we're not hitting GPU quotas. Also checking cloud project quotas now.

raj: if it's helm values drift, we should lock flux automation after the PR and manually trigger a reconcile. Commands: 

```
git checkout -b fix/prod-egress-allow-2024
# edit infra/helm/redwood-api/values-prod.yaml
git commit -am "prod: allow egress for nodepool subnet to fix CNI IPAM"
git push origin fix/prod-egress-allow-2024
# open PR
flux reconcile source git infra-repo
flux reconcile kustomization redwood-prod
```

maria: also running terraform sanity check: 

```
cd infra/gke
terraform plan -var='project=redwood-prod' -var='region=us-west1'
```

leon: quick cost/security note — prefer narrow CIDR instead of 0.0.0.0/0. Adding broad egress temporarily increases cross-region traffic risk. We should document the exception with owner + TTL.

raj: I'll watch the reconcile and standby for rollback. @infra-bot please post status updates when flux applies.

infra-bot: flux apply started for kustomization/redwood-prod at 2024-11-23T14:20Z. Status: in-progress.

sam: if flux hits OPA again, either update the gate policy (with careful review) or patch values then revert. Also add a test to env-diff to assert networkPolicy.* keys exist.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/842 — CI runs on builders/ci-run. Tagging for review. I'll monitor evictions and autoscaler logs.

raj: ACK. standing by to rollback if necessary. If this escalates, create an incident in #incidents and ping paging list.

jen: :thumbsup: add a TODO in the PR to update drift-detector rules and docs.

infra-bot: flux apply completed for kustomization/redwood-prod at 2024-11-23T14:29Z. Status: applied 3 resources. OPA gate evaluation: pass.

maria: monitoring cluster events now — no new pod evictions in last 5m. Will keep watch for 30m window.

sam: follow-up action list: add env-diff rule for required networkPolicy keys, add automated unit test, add terraform alert for GPU quota < 10 to preempt scaling failures.

raj: thanks all, keep updates here.
